threshold.noaa_episode_criterion: At least five consecutive overlapping three-month seasons at or above +0.5 degrees Celsius.
threshold.normalization_basis: historical_distribution_fallback over phase-specific intensity; NOAA episode status retained separately and never inferred from one crossing

extent.definition: ONI is the complete NOAA-defined Niño 3.4 rolling three-month domain measure for this phase; complete node-domain coverage does not mean uniform global impact.

source_snapshot.measurement_boundary: ONI is a rolling three-month Niño 3.4 SST anomaly. A single threshold crossing is not an El Niño or La Niña episode; the snapshot separately reports the five-overlapping-season criterion.

transformations.formula: Map phase-specific ONI intensity and its overlapping-season change through median / p75 / p90 / p97.5 anchors across the complete source history.

receipts.uncertainty: ERSST input, climatology updates and revisions affect ONI. NOAA does not publish an observation-level statistical interval in this table. ONI measures the coupled Pacific state; downstream harm varies by season and geography, and one threshold crossing is not labeled an episode.
receipts.freshness: Official NOAA CPC ONI table through AMJ 2026; snapshot captured 2026-07-25T13:53:30.678Z.
